# AU accounting hotkeys

> Windows AutoHotkey v2 shortcuts for Australian accountants: type financial-year and
> quarter-end dates, and use a searchable picker of period labels, ABN and ACN
> formatting, text transformations and draft workpaper snippets.

Dates and labels assume a 30 June financial-year end. They are period labels, not
lodgement deadlines. ABN and ACN reports check format and checksum only, not
registration, identity, active status or GST registration. Snippets are drafts to
complete and do not establish that a procedure was performed.

## Start

- [README](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-accounting-hotkeys#readme): install AutoHotkey v2, download the repository and run `accounting-hotkeys.ahk`. Insert types the selected financial-year end, for example `30/06/2026`.
- [Command catalogue](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-accounting-hotkeys/blob/main/docs/commands.md): the 45 built-in commands and 12 draft snippets, with input rules and examples.
- [Sources and related projects](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-accounting-hotkeys/blob/main/docs/resources.md): inspected repositories, licences and official references.

## Related

- [Author's site](https://duguid.com.au/): Ryan Duguid's open source Australian accounting tools.
